text: So sorry to bother you, I know you must be busy. My grandson is 3 and he's running a temperature, 38.6 when I checked a little while ago. He's got a bit of a cough as well, nothing heavy, just a little one now and then. Once his medicine kicks in he's back to his usual self, playing with his trains, chatting to me and drinking his juice. I'm probably fussing over nothing but I'd feel better hearing it from someone who knows. Thank you, and sorry again.
